purpose: Development warning-load comparison; no editorial labels or confirmatory inference.
selection: Historical development partition only, documentation/readme, 400-6000 previously measured prose words; SHA-256 order, maximum two pages per provenance group, maximum 40 pages. No selection by diagnostics.
stopping: One paired before/after scan of every selected source; preserve errors. Construction review and fixture edits are exploratory.
forbidden_inference: Neither historical provenance nor absence of warnings supplies a clean-text label.
grouping: Use the global dataset-plan group, not a shard-local measurement group. The initial unmeasured draw was superseded for this reason.
